facts.target_definition: 1 = bad risk (credit contract not complied with), 0 = good risk
facts.data_source: crd.monthly_accounts, work.beh_base (production SAS library, not available)

narrative.purpose: Monthly re-scoring of existing borrowers' probability of default. Business use: Limit management and provisioning inputs.
narrative.methodology: Binary logistic regression estimating the probability of default (PD) as a logit-linear function of the inputs. Categorical inputs enter as dummy variables against a reference level.
assumptions: Log-odds of default are linear in each numeric input (no transformation or binning detected).
Observations are independent; no account-level or time clustering is modelled.
Effects are additive: no interaction terms are specified.
The development sample is representative of the population scored today.
limitations: Cannot capture non-linear effects or interactions unless explicitly engineered.
Developed on 1,000 historical German loans from 1973-1975: a small, old, non-UK sample used here as a stand-in for bank data.
risks: Uses age (protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010) as a direct input. Requires a documented justification and fairness testing before use in customer decisions.
Documentation last reviewed 2017-05 (9.5 years ago): out of date.
Stepwise variable selection is unstable and inflates apparent significance.
Depends on a SAS licence and a production library not available for independent re-execution: the model cannot be validated as-is.
Model could not be executed in the factory, so no performance evidence exists.
